title: Optimized Vanilla Extra (OVE)
description: This modpack optimize Minecraft with a few extras
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b82e2b0b8b3c696f5cfb81297c52b0847a921a1_0.webp)

Optimized Vanilla Extra is a performance‑focused modpack that optimizes Minecraft, streamlines gameplay, and adds powerful tools for building and content creation.

The modpack improves FPS and world performance while keeping the game close to the vanilla experience. It also makes many game mechanics more convenient, so you can focus on exploring, building, and having fun instead of grinding.

**For builders and video creators, Optimized Vanilla Extra includes a carefully selected set of mods and resource packs that make constructing, planning, and recording easier and more enjoyable. You’ll get better visuals, smoother animations, and handy tools to create cinematic videos and impressive builds without sacrificing performance.**

Example:
- [Flashback](https://modrinth.com/mod/flashback)
- [Axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom)
- [Worldedit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit)
- [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)



If you like playing with friends, you can use [Essential Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential). It enables multiplayer in normal Minecraft worlds without any risk. This is not a scam.

If you enjoy Minecraft-style trailers, this modpack is for you. First, OVE adds [Bare Bones](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones) which changes all blocks to look like they do in trailers. Second, OVE adds [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations), [FA: Player Extension](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension), and [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations). These mods and resource packs make Minecraft feel more alive by adding lots of new animations.

Do you think Minecraft already has a lot of advancements? With [BlazeandCave's](https://modrinth.com/datapack/blazeandcaves-advancements-pack))enabled, the game now has over 1,000 advancements.

I hope you enjoy my modpack! :D

If you like this modpack, please consider subscribing to my YouTube channel. [Subscribe here](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCcSVmbZDI9a1En45aHizUKQ)
